name: Ferienwohnung Exenberger
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on the heights of Schwoich, Ferienwohnung Exenberger welcomes guests with a cosy alpine ambiance. The comfortable apartment features bright rooms and a scenic balcony.

Peaceful surroundings encourage scenic walks and bike rides, with Kufstein and the Kaiser hiking trails only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Exenberger in Schwoich offers relaxing holidays and panoramic views of the Kaiser mountains.
